sections.title: Saturn audit procedure
sections.paragraph: Saturn audit evidence is retained in the primary ledger. Saturn audit evidence includes the signed daily checkpoint, the operator record, and the verification receipt. This paragraph describes the primary ledger procedure in detail.

sections.title: Saturn exception
sections.paragraph: Saturn audit evidence for the separate financial exception is retained for seven years in the compliance archive.

sections.title: Meeting agenda
sections.paragraph: The Saturn audit committee discusses catering and staff rotations. This agenda contains no evidence retention rule.

sections.title: Cobalt protocol
sections.paragraph: Cobalt handshake quorum requires two independent signers before a key rotation. Cobalt handshake quorum verification records both signer identities and the approved rotation window.

sections.title: Alpha gate
sections.paragraph: Meridian release gate alpha requires the deployment manifest and checksum before rollout.

sections.title: Beta gate
sections.paragraph: Meridian release gate beta requires a signed operator review before rollout.

sections.title: Gamma gate
sections.paragraph: Meridian release gate gamma requires a recovery drill before rollout.

sections.title: Private project
sections.paragraph: Private stellar reserve belongs to Project B. Saturn audit evidence in this project is never visible in Project A.

sections.title: Private session
sections.paragraph: Private stellar reserve belongs to another session. Saturn audit evidence in this session is never visible in Session A.

sections.title: Retired record
sections.paragraph: Retired nebula code was violet. This record has been deleted and must not return.
